## Change

Describe the affected module and expected behavior.

## Verification

List the commands, actual results and any skipped checks. Include seeds and resource bounds for mathematical or performance changes.

## Review

- [ ] This change preserves the documented model and runtime evidence distinction.
- [ ] New regressions have a focused test where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and reported test evidence reflect the actual implementation.
- [ ] Fixtures and reports contain synthetic data and omit secrets.
